mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which increases risk of QT prolongation and arrhythmias, compounded by dronedarone's inherent Class III antiarrhythmic effects and QT-prolonging potential.
action: Monitor serum potassium and magnesium levels regularly; maintain levels in upper normal range; consider ECG monitoring; ensure adequate electrolyte supplementation if needed.
